# 40 USD sold out of the basis bought at 1.35, valued at that cost.
#
# For the per-currency check: a book needs a sale that names a basis, so the
# two sides of the comparison can be put out of step by removing that basis's
# balance afterwards.
2026-03-01 * "Sell 40 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-54.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis}"
	Assets:Bank 55.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "55.00"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
